json.patch:
@@ -1,6 +1,9 @@
 [flake8]
 max-line-length = 88
 max-complexity = 10
-# These checks violate PEP8 so let's ignore them
-extend-ignore = E203
+extend-ignore =
+    # E203: Whitespace before ':' (violates PEP8 and black style)
+    E203,
+    # B042: Requires calling super().__init__ in custom exceptions
+    B042,
 extend-exclude = */site-packages/*
